t: How to Shop for Vinyl Records Online (2025): Discogs, Ebay | WIRED
s: March 17, 2025 - If you're looking for truly independent music from all over the globe, select the Vinyl tab at the top of the homepage and get to listening. You may have to do a bit of digital crate digging to find something that you like, but that's the best part of visiting record stores in person anyway. Shop till your eyes drop. You can digitally search for tags, genres, and locations at the top, and I recommend you do so if you're looking for something specific. It can be helpful if you are trying to buy something from your home town, for example.
